notes.title: Level Editor Beta Update - Build 2025_05_08
notes.notes:
A new update is available for the [editor_testing] beta branch!

For this update I've focus on improving the workshop publishing features and Quality-of-life features and improvements for the editor. Most of the essential functionality is there now and it's possible to build, publish and play user-made levels already!


Here's the full list of changes for this update:

New content / features:
- smoke and fire vfx assets added
- toggle visibility of all objects in an outliner category
- toggle locked state of all objects in an outliner category
- added option to update existing workshop item
- button added for opening published level in workshop

Improvements:
- publish window checklist added
- publish window level preview added
- inspector now supports multi-editing position/rotation/scale per axis
- xyz for position, rotation and scale now draggable in the inspector
- enclosed box selection now works better with scaled objects and has padding

Fixes:
- bug fix: barge buttons broken in game
- bug fix: gate position ignored in custom levels
- bug fix: level framing now consistent between editor and game
- bug fix: medal time inputs offset with scrolling


Huge thanks to everyone building levels and posting feedback! It makes all the difference :)

For anyone who wants to try out the editor and workshop, there's a full guide here on how to run the editor beta: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1358790/announcements/detail/529843687122797519


Next up I will be focusing on getting the tool for painting the ground working and getting the remaining assets into the editor. I will also be fixing bugs and continue the work on making the editor a nice tool to spend time in!


/ Pontus

notes.title: Level Editor Beta Update - Build 2025_04_16
notes.notes:
A small update for the editor_testing beta branch, with a few new features, improvements and fixes.

Full list of changes:

New content / features:
- global fog actor added
- new option for partial/enclosed box selection behavior
- road assets added
- new large corner asset added for metal railing 1 set

Improvements:
- hotkeys added for "toggle widget global axis" (T) and "toggle transform as group" (G)
- notes added to global lighting asset
- thumbnail images added for all currently available wall assets

Fixes:
- bug fix: game freezes when playing custom level without player count set
- bug fix: dummy ground plane left in editor scene
- bug fix: temp level details showing when no level selected in file window
- bug fix: player count not updating when selecting level in load/save window
- bug fix: potential fix for null ref when undoing "duplicate object"



Thanks to everyone for posting bugs and giving feedback on Discord!

/ Pontus

notes.title: Version 1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hi there lovely players, Pontus here. I've just released the first major update for Tipston - Version 1.1!

My main focus for this update has been to expand and improve upon the solo campaign, as well as other smaller improvements and fixes. Initially the game was supposed to be co-op only, but late in development I decided to include some content that could be played by one person - and good thing I did! Turns out a lot of players have enjoyed the solo campaign, so I made 6 more solo levels to make it a better experience :)


Here's the full list of updates:


🗺️ NEW SOLO LEVELS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626761/14660808a4f21de0fc3b239c017bbf04b37dcc0f.png

 Timber Transfer (Beginner)
 Spotty Placements (Beginner)
 Turbine Trouble (Easy)
 Carry On (Hard)
 The Clog (Hard)
 Hasty Rummage (Extreme)



🎨 NEW AND IMPROVED PLAYER COLORS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626761/93280aeb54949e6e70918cd0a27ffdb27b4c81d5.png

 6 new paint blocks added to the garage
 Some colors have been tweaked to be more distinct and look nicer



✨ IMPROVEMENTS

 German localization has been improved - Huge thanks to "west" on the official Discord server!
 Keyboard controls for selected layout now shown in the player menu
 Art pass on levels "Excess Express" (1P), "Across n' Around" (1P) and "Flip Flop Junk Drop" (1P)



🥇 BALANCING

 Unlocking level packs in the solo campaign is now easier
 Some gold medals are now easier to achieve in the solo campaign
 The times for the higher medals are now harder for the later levels in the 2P campaign

I apologize in advance for any medals gained or lost due to my balancing changes - I hope the time limits are more consistent now - I don't want to change them again 🫠

Finding appropriate time limits for all medals on all levels across all player counts is no simple task. It's taken a lot of playing the game, listening to feedback and comparing records. My goal has been to find a balance between giving new and inexperienced players a fun challenge, while more experienced players can aim for the higher medals with a steady increase in difficulty.


🛠️ GENERAL FIXES

 Some of the prompt screens having missing localization or wrong information
 UI buttons in pause menu not centered in all aspect ratios
 Level difficulty not matching pack difficulty in solo campaign
 Player color resets to default color when returning to home level after rejoining player or resetting settings


🛠️ LEVEL SPECIFIC FIXES

 Junk gets stuck on conveyors easily on levels "Auto Loader" (2P) and "This Side That Side" (2P)
 Dumping amount text in Planning Phase covered by player spawners on level "Storeroom Squeeze" (3/4P)
 Track marks leave stretched artifacts outside play area on level "Downstream" (1P)
 Dust effect shows when driving on wooden deck and barge on level "Floating Bridge" (2P)




What else is going on?


❄️ STEAM WINTER SALE

Tipston Salvage will be available at a 25% discount during the Steam Winter Sale, which takes place on Steam between the 19th of December to 2nd of January! A great time to get a new co-op game for the holiday season! 👀



And lastly, a huge thank you to everyone for playing!

It has been incredible to see the reception and reading all the reviews and comments! I hope you'll enjoy this update! If you have any feedback or questions, don't hesitate to write. I do my best to respond to all the posts I can find, but the fastest way to get in touch is on the official Discord Server!

Thank you all so much for the support! ❤️


Have a nice winter holiday!


/ Pontus

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello dear junkyard enthusiasts, today I have some exciting news to share!

Tipston Salvage will be releasing on October 10th at 5PM CEST!

In less than a month you will be able to take on all the teamwork challenges that the city of Tipston has to offer. I'm also preparing an updated version of the demo that will include 3 more solo levels as well as improvements and fixes.


Thank you all so much for checking out my game and trying the demo. Can't wait to hear what you think of the full game!


/ Pontus
